title: Animal feeds and feeding stuffs - Determination of aflatoxin B-1 content
clause_1_scope: Amendment to IS 13427 (Animal feeds and feeding stuffs - Determination of aflatoxin B-1 content): AMENDMENT NO. 1 AUGUST 1993 TO / ISO 6651 : 1987 ANIMAL FEEDS AND FEEDING STUFFS —DETERMINATION OF AFLATOXIN Bi CONTENT ( Page 8, clause 92) — Add the following note under clause 92 : 'NOTE — In the Indian context the collaborative study on the same feed samples between laboratories have indicated the variation of: a) 50% of the mean value for mean value of anatoxin Bi between 10 to 20 ppb, and b) 30% of mean value for the mean value of aflatoxin Bi above 20 ppb.' (FAD5) Reprography Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India ISO 6651 :1987 Indian Standard ANIMAL FEEDS AND FEEDING STUFFS - DETERMINATION OF AF

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
